name: What is the typical timeline for a basement drywall installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a basement drywall installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for basement drywall installation depends on the basement's size and complexity. For an average 500-1000 sq ft basement, the process typically takes 3 to 7 days. This includes hanging sheets, taping, mudding, sanding, and a final inspection. This estimate assumes adequate framing is already in place. Larger basements or those requiring extensive prep work like insulation or electrical rough-in will naturally take longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical basement drywall installation takes 3-7 days for an average-sized basement, including hanging, taping, and finishing.
